FAQ
Are there any contract commitments?
Jobber offers several plans with different pricing and billing options to help meet the needs of your business.
Monthly Billing  (no commitment)
If you subscribe to Jobber on a monthly plan with no commitment, you can cancel at any time. Your subscription will end at the end of your current billing period. You won’t be charged again.
Monthly Billing (1 year commitment)
If you subscribe to a monthly 1 year commitment, your subscription has a 12-month minimum term, billed monthly. If you cancel during the year, your subscription will remain active and you’ll continue to be billed monthly until the end of the 12-month term.
Annual (prepaid)
If you subscribe to Jobber on an annual plan, you’ll be billed for the full term at the start of your subscription. If you cancel during the year, you’ll continue to have access until the end of your annual term, but your initial payment is non-refundable.
All subscriptions automatically renew at the end of the current term unless set to non-renew in accordance with Jobber’s
Terms of Service
.
How does the free trial work?
For 14 days you get full access to all of Jobber’s features on the Grow plan—no credit card required.
When you’re nearing the end of your trial we’ll send you a reminder to enter your billing information to ensure uninterrupted service. You can enter your billing information on your account billing page. If your account does expire before you enter your billing information don’t worry, nothing will be deleted. You can access your account billing page to enter your info and continue using the software.
How do I know which plan is best for my business?
Our plans are built to offer you the most commonly required feature needs based on your company size and the number of employees using Jobber.
Can I change plans?
You can upgrade your plan at any time. You can downgrade your plan at the end of your current billing cycle—month-to-month or annual. Visit your account billing page to change plans.
What accounting software does Jobber sync with?
Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online. Learn more on our
integrations page
.
What if I’m a franchise with multiple locations?
Jobber partners with franchises big and small to provide custom solutions and dedicated support.
With all your teams using Jobber, you’ll be able to grow your business, deliver consistent customer service, and maintain visibility of your entire operations.
Learn more
about our Franchise Partnership Program.
Is the Jobber app available in Spanish?
Yes! The Jobber mobile app is available in Spanish to all team members, with the exception of administrators and account owners. Spanish-speaking team members will be able to access the same functionality as in the English-language app, like schedule management, completing work, starting and stopping timers, and (if user permissions allow) invoicing and collecting payment. Download it now on the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

The Core Plan
5 min read
Updated August 13, 2026
Overview
The Core plan supports one user and an unlimited number of quotes, jobs, and invoices. Whether you’re running a side gig or expanding your new business, the Core plan is a good fit for solopreneurs with a growing amount of work.
Learn more about
Jobber’s pricing plans
.
Gain new business and manage your leads
Requests
&
Online Booking
– Let your clients or new leads request work through your website or client hub, or book directly into your calendar with online booking. Requests are online forms hosted by Jobber that allow your clients to request work to be done and then from your Jobber account you can decide what’s next. These forms can be put on your website, social media pages, or clients can use the form by logging into client hub.
Lead Management
— Track your leads and manage client details whether you’re at the office or out in the field. Lead management functionality allows you to track important customer details as they progress from a lead to a client.
Organize your operations
Quotes
– Create professional quotes customized with your company branding. The Core plan offers an unlimited number of quotes, so you can provide each client a quote that’s unique to their needs.
Jobs
– Create an unlimited number of jobs to build your schedule. Every appointment is tracked in the Jobber calendar, making it easy to communicate to your clients and crew.
Invoices
– Invoicing can be time consuming, but Jobber is here to help. With one click, create professional invoices with details directly from the job that your clients can easily pay online. The Core plan offers an unlimited number of invoices.
Receptionist–Powered by Jobber AI
: Available as an add-on to the Core Plan, your AI-powered Receptionist answers calls and texts 24/7 so you can take time away from your phone without risking a missed lead or frustrated client. It handles customer inquiries, captures lead information, and can even help book jobs right into your calendar — all while you’re on a job site, focused on more important work.
Get paid faster
Jobber Payments
– Get paid on average 4x faster than checks when your clients pay with debit or credit. No more waiting for checks in the mail! Jobber Payments is our fully integrated payment processing platform that gives your clients an online payment option. Jobber Payments enables you to store client card information, collect tips, and process payments and deposits.
Instant Payouts
– Instant payouts are available on the Core plan so you can receive funds that would normally take two business days to be deposited into your bank account within minutes. These pending funds can be transferred directly to your debit card within minutes, 24/7 for an additional 1% fee.
Jobber Payments is available in the
UK
, US, and Canada.
Learn the core account workflow
Meet Graham.
He’s going to tell you about how he uses Jobber throughout his work day, moving through each step of his workflow. He receives a request, which then becomes a quote, is scheduled into a job, then the job becomes an invoice, and the invoice gets paid.
Note
: Optional line items and on my way text messages are not available on Core.
Core account workflow
These steps show the flow of work using the features available on a Core subscription.
Step 1:
Request
— Requests are the first optional step in the Jobber workflow. They can be created either internally or submitted by your clients online. Requests can be converted to a quote or job depending on what your next steps are.
Step 2:
Quote
— Let your clients know what services and costs they’re looking at. Create a quote and send it! Quotes can be viewed and approved online.
Step 3:
Job
— Set up a job with either a recurring or one-off schedule, assign your team, and enter your line items.
Step 4:
Invoice
— It’s time to bill your client for services rendered. Create an invoice, send it off, and wait for that payment to roll in.
Step 5:
Payment
— Congrats! You’ve been paid. Now it’s time to record it in Jobber.
Learn more about getting started on the Core plan.

The Connect Plan
5 min read
Updated August 13, 2026
Overview
The Connect plan is our most popular plan. This plan is designed for building efficient processes that better connect your team and impress your customers. The Connect plan supports up to 5 users. Whether you are new to the Connect plan or are considering upgrading your current plan, this article outlines the key features that are on Connect.
Learn more about our
pricing plans
.
Easy scheduling & tracking
Requests & Online booking
– Let your clients or new leads request work through your website or client hub, or book directly from Google search when you connect Jobber to your
Local Services Ads
. Requests are online forms hosted by Jobber that allow your clients to request work to be done and then from your Jobber account you can decide what’s next. These forms can be put on your website, social media pages, or clients can use the form by logging into client hub.
Routing
– Efficiently route the day’s work, assign incoming jobs to the closest team member on the map, and know their whereabouts as they’re on the move.
Live GPS tracking powered by FleetSharp
– Track your vehicles in real time and use their location to make scheduling decisions based on location. FleetSharp shows the vehicle’s speed, direction, fuel level, mileage, and check engine light on the map view in Jobber.
Lead Management
— Track your leads and manage client details whether you’re at the office or out in the field. Lead management functionality allows you to track important customer details as they progress from a lead to a client.
Get paid faster
Jobber Payments
— Get paid on average 4x faster than checks when your clients pay with debit or credit. No more waiting for checks in the mail!
Jobber Payments is our fully integrated payment processing platform that lets you manage client card information, payments, and deposits in Jobber.
Automatic Payments
is available on the Connect plan where clients can
save a card on file
that can be charged automatically according to a schedule.
Jobber Payments is available in the
UK
, US, and Canada.
QuickBooks Online Integration
– Our sync works behind the scenes to make sure your accounting needs are covered, while you use Jobber to power your day-to-day operations.
Always-on communications
Automated emails and texts
– Keep clients informed before, during and after the work — with less effort. You can customize and automate messages like appointment reminders to make sure you aren’t surprising your clients or catching them off guard when you show up!
Automated referrals
— Word of mouth has moved online. Jobber makes it easy for your clients to refer their friends over email, text, or social media, as soon as the job is complete. All you have to do is deliver 5-star service that your clients want to spread the word about!
Receptionist–Powered by Jobber AI
: Available as an add-on to the Connect Plan, your AI-powered Receptionist answers calls and texts 24/7 so you can take time away from your phone without risking a missed lead or frustrated client. It handles customer inquiries, captures lead information, and can even help book jobs right into your calendar — all while you’re on a job site, focused on more important work.
Organize your operations
Custom fields
– Every business is different. Track whatever additional information is important to you-like entry codes, pets at the property, or referral name. Custom fields can be added into reports as an additional column.
Activity feed
– Keep a pulse on the everyday activities happening in your business and stay on top of who is doing what, when, and where.
Task Automation–Powered by Zapier
— Zapier is an online automation tool that can be used to connect two apps that do not have a direct integration. Automate repetitive tasks by setting up triggers in one app to automatically complete actions in another.
Workflow
Your workflow is the step-by-step progression of your work from start to finish. Or mid-point to finish. What your workflow looks like might vary from project-to-project, but requests, quotes, jobs, invoices, and finally payment are the building blocks of your workflow in Jobber. You don’t need to have all these steps in your workflow, but they do typically fall in this order:
Step 1:
Request
— Requests are the first optional step in the Jobber workflow on the Connect plan. They can be created either internally or submitted by your clients online. Requests can be converted to a quote or job depending on what your next steps are.
Step 2:
Quote
— Let your clients know what services and costs they’re looking at. Create a quote and send it! Quotes can be viewed and approved online.
Step 3:
Job
— Set up a job with either a recurring or one-off schedule, assign your team, and enter your line items.
Step 4:
Invoice
— It’s time to bill your client for services rendered. Create an invoice, send it off, and wait for that payment to roll in.
Step 5:
Payment
— Congrats! You’ve been paid. Now it’s time to record it in Jobber.

2026 FIELD SERVICE SOFTWARE COMPARISON
Housecall Pro vs. other field service software
Most field service management (FSM) platforms can schedule a job and send an invoice. The difference shows up in what happens between those steps: how much your office still has to handle by hand, whether the AI tools are built into the platform or patched in from somewhere else, and whether the software can carry a 50-technician operation or tops out at 10.
Here’s what you get with Housecall Pro that most platforms in this category don’t offer.
An AI customer service rep that books jobs while you’re in the field
CSR AI, our AI customer service rep, handles inbound calls and website chats on your behalf. It books jobs, manages existing appointments, runs custom scripts, and escalates to a human when the situation calls for it. When a chat wraps up, a summary lands in your inbox. Most FSM platforms don’t include this kind of native AI intake at all, and few combine phone and chat handling in a single built-in tool.
Five AI tools, not one
You get CSR AI for customer intake, Analyst AI for conversational reporting directly from your dashboard, Marketing AI for writing emails and review responses, Coach AI for hiring and growth questions, and Help AI for how-to and account support. Analyst AI, Marketing AI, Coach AI, and Help AI are included with your plan at no extra cost. CSR AI is available as an add-on. None of the five require a separate subscription with a third-party vendor.
Route-based dispatch with real-time GPS
Before you send anyone out, you can plan and view technician routes, then adjust them in real time when jobs change. Customers get a live “On My Way” link that shows your tech’s actual location. Map View shows your whole team on one screen. Most schedulers give you a calendar with tech assignment. This is a full dispatch tool.
Trade-specific packages for HVAC, plumbing, and electrical
Your platform comes configured for your trade: flat-rate pricebooks, KPI (key performance indicator) dashboards built around the metrics that matter for your work, and workflow templates that reflect how trade jobs actually run. That’s a real difference from a general-purpose FSM platform where you build those structures yourself.
From estimate to cash, in one place
You build estimates with photos and line items, capture customer signatures digitally or in person, set expiration dates, and convert accepted estimates directly into scheduled jobs. Invoicing, payment reminders, card-on-file capture, and two-way QuickBooks sync all connect to the same record. Nothing requires a handoff to another tool.
Online booking that connects to Google
Reserve with Google lets your customers book from Google Search and Google Maps without calling your office. Your customer portal handles appointment management, invoice viewing, and payment on their end. A solid portion of inbound volume can move without anyone picking up the phone.
Multi-day job management
Jobs that span multiple days or need multiple technicians run under one job record. Each visit gets its own scheduled appointment and its own “On My Way” notification, while time tracking stays shared at the job level.

How to Use Price Book by Housecall Pro
Price book by Housecall Pro streamline pricing with homeowner-friendly descriptions that highlight the value of your work.
July 15, 2026
Table of contents
What is the Price Book by Housecall Pro?
The Price Book by Housecall Pro is a free collection of common services tailored for your industry. These services come with detailed descriptions aimed at communicating the value you offer to homeowners.
Default Price books by Industry
Every industry in Housecall Pro comes with a Default Price Book,  a pre-loaded set of common services and homeowner-friendly descriptions tailored to that trade, so you can start scheduling jobs without building your price book from scratch.
Mechanical industries, HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical include a more extensive Default Price Book. These trades come with a deeper set of pre-built categories and common services (e.g., condensers, filters, refrigerant for HVAC) compared to the standard default books offered for other industries.
All Default Price Books include homeowner-friendly service descriptions designed to build trust and communicate value.
Mechanical Default Price Books are more comprehensive, covering a wider range of common jobs specific to HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical work.
You can still customize any Default Price Book, edit descriptions, add your own pricing, or add new services, regardless of industry.
How to Access Your Price Book
To access the Price book by Housecall Pro:
Go to
Price book
in the left navigation bar of your Housecall Pro account on the web.
In the Price book menu at the top, select any of the following:
Services
Materials
Pricing forms
Estimate Templates
Discounts
Navigating the Price Book by Housecall Pro
When you access the Price book by Housecall Pro:
Industries:
Categories are organized into a predetermined industry. (e.g., Plumbing, HVAC, Electrical)
Categories:
Services are organized into relevant categories.  (e.g., Condenser, Filters, Refrigerant) Click on any category to view the available services.
Services:
Each service includes a homeowner-friendly description designed to showcase the value of your work.
Book Online Today Category:
We’ve pre-enabled these services for online booking. To make them available, just complete the online booking setup when you're ready.
Customizing Your Price Book
The Price book by Housecall Pro allows you to customize your services:
Edit Service Descriptions:
Click on any service to modify the description to better fit your offerings
Enter Your Pricing:
Since pricing is not included in the Free Price Book, you’ll need to enter your own pricing for each service.
Add New Services:
If you provide a service not listed in the Free Price Book, you can add it by selecting “Add Service” and filling out the relevant details.
Add image:
Click on any service and add a customized photo.
Pricing Insights
Pricing Insights helps Mechanical Pros understand how their Default Price Book pricing compares to similar businesses, so they can price with confidence. It's powered by Housecall Pro's proprietary dataset of millions of real jobs, giving you a data-backed view of your local market.
Availability:
Pricing Insights is only available on the Max plan for Pros with the Mechanical Package (HVAC, Plumbing, and Electrical).
Market-Based Benchmarking:
See how your service pricing compares to similar Pros by industry, region, and job type.
Full Control:
Review the insights and decide whether to update your pricing — Pricing Insights never automatically changes, sets, or applies prices for you.
Built into Price Book:
Access insights directly within your Default Price Book while setting up or updating services, with no need to switch tools.
📌
Note:
Pricing Insights is currently available for Default Price Books only and is not yet available for custom price books or pricing forms.
Using the Price book in Estimates and Jobs
You can use the Price book by Housecall Pro to streamline your estimates and jobs:
Select services from the Price book when creating an estimate to auto-populate descriptions.
Adjust pricing as needed for each job based on your own pricing structure.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
Can I add my custom services to the Free Price book?
Yes, you can add, edit, or remove services as needed to fit your business.
How do I update pricing for services?
You will need to manually enter your pricing for each service in your Price Book.
